text:
ana: Heads-up — Trucorp wants a non-standard billing: 60% annual prepay, 40% invoiced post-pilot net60. They also want an escrow clause for the pilot holdback.

sam: Oof. Are they asking for a formal escrow or just the language in the MSA?

ana: Maria (customer) pasted proposed contract language. They want the holdback (25% of total) in escrow until pilot acceptance criteria met. Rest of prepay runs at signing.

maria-customer: Hi team — we can do 60% upfront, 40% post-pilot on Net60. Pilot acceptance: 90% of agreed SLAs for 14 days. Escrow preferred to satisfy procurement. Happy to share redlines. :wave:

katie: Finance note — 60% upfront okay, but collections needs credit sign-off for Net60 on the remainder. Also need to confirm tax handling for EU entities (VAT).

sam: From pricing POV, this is fine if legal signs off on escrow language and deal desk approves the Net60 exception for the remainder. Will we require higher commit discount because of extended terms?

ana: Customer asked for 20% discount off list if we accept this schedule. That seems steep. They're a mid-market account with potential to grow.

katie: Recommend counter: 10% discount if they move to 70% upfront, or keep 60% upfront and 12% discount + calendar-year true-up. That protects us.

tom: Legal flagged two items on escrow: (1) neutral escrow agent clause required, (2) explicit pilot acceptance criteria embedded in SOW. We should avoid custody of funds.

dealdesk-bot: New deal desk task created: DD-4521 — review discount & payment terms exception for Trucorp. Assigned to sam & katie. ETA 48h.

sam: Adding risk note: Net60 increases DSO risk and may require a credit hold if customer misses milestone. Recommend auto-fallback to hosted rate if pilot fails.

ana: Can we get a quick approval path? Customer wants to close by end of quarter.

katie: I'll run credit check today and calc impact to cashflow. If credit passes and legal approves escrow language, I can sign off on Net60 exception up to $250k. Above that needs VP approval.

tom: I'll draft escrow clause and require the neutral escrow agent + escrow release trigger linked to SOW sign-off. Will post redline here by EOD.

sam: Deal desk — please confirm discount cap and whether we need a fidelity/holdback reserve on our side for KPIs.

dealdesk-bot: DD-4521 update: pending katie credit check + tom legal redline. Target decision window: 72 hours.

maria-customer: Appreciate the fast turnaround. If helpful, we can accept 65% upfront instead of 60% to get a better discount. Open to compromise. :+1:

ana: Noted. I'll propose 65% upfront + 10% discount, escrow for 20% until pilot sign-off, remainder Net60.

katie: That path probably clears finance. Proceeding with credit check now. Will post results here.

tom: Redline uploaded: `escrow_agent: "TBD-neutral"; release_on: "SOW acceptance criteria (signed by both parties)"; funds_return: "30 days if disputed"`. Putting it in Slack so we can iterate.

sam: Thanks. If deal desk approves, we'll record the special terms in the contract metadata and flag for collections to monitor.

ana: Great — I'll update Maria and request final confirmation on the 65%/10% counter.

maria-customer: Confirmed — 65% upfront + 10% discount works. Send updated SOW and MSA redlines and we can get signatures this week.

katie: Credit check: PASS. Customer is on file with moderate credit; recommend standard invoicing controls and 30-day payment reminders.

dealdesk-bot: DD-4521 CLOSED — Approved by deal desk (sam) for up to $300k with 10% discount and 65% upfront. Conditions: neutral escrow agent, SOW acceptance criteria in MSA, collections notifications on Net60 invoices.

ana: Thanks everyone. Closing action items: tom to finalize redlines, legal to insert escrow agent, katie to set up invoices and collections rules, sam to update deal metadata. I'll coordinate signatures. :tada:
